claims.claim: Native Windows verification now exclusively creates one isolated root inside per-execution Runtime verification state and binds TEMP, TMP, and TMPDIR to it through a copied environment while preserving unrelated values and strict UTF-8 behavior.

Isolation remains command-neutral: command construction, ordering, evidence command text, subject SHA, single-execution behavior, and genuine nonzero failure semantics are unchanged, while isolation setup failures stop before runner invocation.

Non-Windows environment behavior remains unchanged, with deterministic offline regression coverage for Windows variable convergence, execution isolation, fail-closed setup, process-environment immutability, unchanged command semantics, and nonzero failures.
